# Previous-release marker fixture

`v0.4.2-remix-marker.json` was generated by the public
`RemixMarkerClient::mark_remixed` API in TinyMemes v0.4.2, running its compiled
module against that release's real TSD 1.6.0 memory engine. The generator
records the written collection, key, schema, expiry, and body from the engine
readback; the test does not hand-author the marker document.

The writer source is TinyMemes tag `v0.4.2` at
`b48dda71b1c1fae8e5fc320528aeb3533eb05fc5`. Its checked-in lockfile resolves
TSD 1.6.0 to `1af91acc23a4595e05ea90400d7c922a1c11444d`. Regenerate it from a
checkout of this repository with `scripts/generate-v0.4.2-marker-fixture.sh`.
The script archives the tagged source under ignored `target/`, appends
`scripts/legacy-v0.4.2-marker-fixture-test.rs` to the archived
`crates/tinymemes-module/tests/remix_markers.rs`, builds the old module, and
runs that test against the archived release's locked storage engine. The
test records the actual public-writer readback. TSD-generated metadata such as
creation time can vary between regenerations; the tracked fixture contains the
values emitted by its recorded writer run. The checked fixture's SHA-256 is
`51b4863972e7f66b20c3d29cc105440d9147060c06f69c2f788bf0e64b163197`.
